Delhi AQI Data Mystery: Were Pollution Readings Hidden on Diwali Night?
Several AQI monitoring stations in Delhi were reportedly offline, while some recorded unusual readings during Diwali night. Were Delhi's pollution levels accurately reported? Was crucial AQI data missing or misleading?
Watch this report to uncover what happened to Delhi's air quality data and what the monitoring stations revealed on Diwali night.
